services.name: Own Boat
services.desc: Your Boat + Our Captain! There is no better way to enjoy your beautiful boat around Nantucket than bringing along one of our expert captains so you can actually RELAX and FISH with your family or friends. Let us handle the boat and facilitate the fishing while you enjoy yourself and your boat! LEARN! If you're looking to build you knowledge of Nantucket fishing, become more comfortable running your boat in our shallow waters, or the basics of boat handling, equipment, or electronics, The absolute best way is first hand and hands on with one of us there to help.
